card.name: Leading digits before a thousands comma
card.fires_on: The last digit typed before a comma that separates thousands in a number such as 60,000 or 5,000. Also fires on a few other words right before a comma or closing quote in dictionary-style glosses.

modes.label: Digit before thousands comma
modes.description: A digit in a large number whose next character is the comma before three zeros, often in doses, counts or concentrations.

modes.label: Gloss before comma
modes.description: The last word of a quoted translation in an etymology, right before a comma or closing quote.

card.writes: It promotes commas, mainly Chinese and Arabic ones, and suppresses code-style quote-comma endings, so it expects a comma next.
card.plain: It fires on the digit just before the comma in a number like 25,000, as the model predicts that comma.
